title: Simulator initialization span
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a finite alphabet, let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over $\Gamma$ with $k$ work tapes, choose $a_0\in\Gamma$, and let $x$ be any word over the enlarged sweep alphabet. Starting from the augmented simulator's initial configuration on $x$, after $2k+2$ steps it reaches the encoded initial configuration of $M$ on the retracted word, with the simulator in its left-growth phase and frontier $-1$. Throughout these steps the work-tape head remains between $-1$ and $k$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over $\Gamma$
An arbitrary word $x$ over the enlarged sweep alphabet
